title: Presheaf inverse image of modules is left adjoint to direct image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map of topological spaces, $\mathcal O$ a presheaf of commutative rings on $Y$, and let $f_p$, $f_*$ and the unit $i_{\mathcal G}:\mathcal G\to f_*f_p\mathcal G$ of the adjunction $f_p\dashv f_*$ on presheaves of sets, abelian groups and commutative rings be as in [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (2), with $f_p\mathcal G(U)=\varinjlim_{V\supseteq f(U)}\mathcal G(V)$ and coprojections $\iota^U_V$. (1) For a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $\mathcal G$ on $Y$ [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], there is a unique map $f_p\mathcal O(U)\times f_p\mathcal G(U)\to f_p\mathcal G(U)$ for every open $U\subseteq X$ with $\iota^U_V(a)\cdot\iota^U_V(g)=\iota^U_V(ag)$ for all $V\supseteq f(U)$, $a\in\mathcal O(V)$, $g\in\mathcal G(V)$; it makes the presheaf of abelian groups $f_p\mathcal G$ a presheaf of $f_p\mathcal O$-modules, and for a morphism of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules $u$, $f_pu$ is $f_p\mathcal O$-linear. (2) For a presheaf of $f_p\mathcal O$-modules $\mathcal F$ on $X$, the presheaf of abelian groups $f_*\mathcal F$, $V\mapsto\mathcal F(f^{-1}V)$, is a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules with $a\in\mathcal O(V)$ acting on $\mathcal F(f^{-1}V)$ through $i_{\mathcal O,V}(a)\in f_p\mathcal O(f^{-1}V)$; for a morphism of presheaves of $f_p\mathcal O$-modules $w$, $f_*w$ is $\mathcal O$-linear. (3) The bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{PAb}(X)}(f_p\mathcal G,\mathcal F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{PAb}(Y)}(\mathcal G,f_*\mathcal F)$, $\psi\mapsto f_*\psi\circ i_{\mathcal G}$, of the adjunction $f_p\dashv f_*$ on presheaves of abelian groups maps the $f_p\mathcal O$-linear morphisms exactly onto the $\mathcal O$-linear ones, and so restricts to a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{PMod}(f_p\mathcal O)}(f_p\mathcal G,\mathcal F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal O)}(\mathcal G,f_*\mathcal F)$, natural in $\mathcal G$ and $\mathcal F$.

proof.text: Take the Mathlib abstract module pullback P and adjunction for iO. The abelian adjunct of its forgotten unit is an isomorphism by the comparison lemma. Naturality of the Hom equivalences and the module unit makes these maps a natural isomorphism. Take its inverse to obtain e.

proof.text: The abelian Hom inverse identity gives the unit formula for e. Naturality expresses its inverse on a coprojection as restriction of the module unit. Linearity of the unit and semilinearity of restrictions yield the required coprojection scalar-action formula.

proof.text: Transport the scalar action on P(G)(U) through e. The scalar-action formula and inverse identities give its coprojection formula. Any other such multiplication agrees everywhere, because common representatives express both inputs at one neighbourhood.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks Sheaves 008T, 008S, 008U (sheaves.tex lines 2693-2830) and the passages their proofs cite: section 008N (lines 2600-2630; i_G, c_F, the presheaf adjunction for algebraic structures), 008F (lemma-pullback-presheaves, for i_G and c_F) and Categories 002W (directed colimits commute with finite limits); all tags verified in tags/tags. Statement kept. Split in 8 steps following the source: step 1 the elementwise description of f_pO(U), f_pG(U) as filtered colimits (it replaces the source's appeal to 002W: the source identifies colim O(V) x colim G(V) with colim (O(V) x G(V)) in sets, which also needs the fact, left implicit, that filtered colimits of rings and abelian groups are computed on underlying sets; the elementwise lemmas give both at once); steps 2-3 the product of 008T, its independence of representatives, the module axioms, semilinear restrictions and linearity of f_pu (all left to the reader in the source); step 4 the O-module f_*F of 008S/008U through i_O; step 5 the abelian bijection psi -> f_*psi o i_G and the formula psi_U o iota^U_V = rho o phi_V; steps 6-7 the two linearity checks 008U leaves to the reader, step 7 by direct computation via the colimit formula instead of the counit c_F (which [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] does not state); step 8 the restricted bijection and its naturality. One new node, the Mathlib leaf lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise (representatives and equality at a later stage in a filtered colimit of commutative rings: Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep / isColimit_rep_eq_iff_exists with CommRingCat.FilteredColimits.forget_preservesFilteredColimits); for abelian groups the existing Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise (R = Z) is used; everything else is computation with representatives.
